name: Complex of Hué Monuments
description: Hué, in central Viet Nam, was the imperial capital of the Nguyen dynasty from 1802 until 1945. Walled citadels nest inside one another along the Perfume River, with the Forbidden Purple City at the heart. Outside town, emperors' tombs and pagodas sit among hills and gardens, each placed to follow traditional ideas of geomancy.
